blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: An agent or robot in a scanned building must locate its camera in rooms that no model saw during training. Point cloud registration methods can align each RGB-D frame with the building's colored point cloud, accurately but at a high cost. We observe that geometric refinement brings nearby initial poses to the same final pose, so the learned component only needs to find the place. Kolibri does this with a graph network of 55,712 parameters that describes 10 cm cubes of points, called cells, by their color, local shape and neighbors. With the same refinement, it matches GeDi on 96 unseen ScanNet rooms (81.4% against 80.3% within 5 cm and 5°) and on a held-out test of 10 further rooms, in 82 ms per frame on an RTX 2080 Ti. The saved time allows for search without a room label. In one point cloud of 100 rooms, Kolibri loses 1.3 points against knowing the room, while retrieving the room first loses 56.0. In a hospital emergency department scene from a real scan, it localizes 86.5% of the frames rendered from the scan in 384 ms each, where GeDi needs 91 minutes per frame on cubes of the scan for a similar recall. The method needs colors that agree between the frame and the point cloud. On gray frames and across cameras with different color responses, point cloud registration methods keep the lead.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
We scanned the emergency department of a university hospital on foot with a handheld laser scanner (BLK2GO) and obtained a colored point cloud of it.
Robots and simulated pedestrian agents need to locate their cameras anywhere in it, without a room label or an initial position.
Each view forms a RGB-D frame, with paired color with depth, so point cloud registration methods can align it with the point cloud.
The difficulty is cost.
On views rendered from the scan with simulated depth noise, GeDi [ 33 ] needs 91 minutes per frame to search overlapping cubes of the scan, while Kolibri, the method we present here, reaches a similar recall on the whole scan in 384 ms.
The rendered colors agree with the point cloud by construction, and the baseline comparison uses 30 frames, one per walk ( Sec. 4.5 ).
The hospital scan motivated the method but remained untouched while we developed it on public benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
我们用手持激光扫描仪(BLK2GO)徒步扫描了一所大学医院的急诊部,并获得其彩色点云.
机器人和模拟行人特工需要将相机定位在其中任何地方,没有房间标签或初始位置.
每个视图形成RGB-D框架,配色与深度,因此点云注册方法可以与点云对齐.
困难在于成本。
GeDi[33]在通过模拟深度噪声扫描得到的视图上,每帧需要91分钟来搜索扫描的重叠立方体,而我们在这里介绍的方法Kolibri在全扫描上以384ms达到类似的回溯.
制成的颜色通过构造与点云一致,基线比较使用30帧,每行1帧(第4.5节)。
医院扫描激发了这一方法,但仍未改变。

blocks.en:
A descriptor summarizes the shape or color around a point as a vector, so that the same surface seen twice can be matched.
Point cloud registration methods spend time computing these descriptors and searching for consistent matches.
Even in a single room, BUFFER-X [ 39 ] takes a median 1.4 s per frame and GeDi 24 s on an RTX 2080 Ti when assigned to align overlapping fragments.
At building scale, searching separate rooms or cubes repeats that work.
Image retrieval can narrow the search, but choosing the wrong room loses the frame before pose estimation begins.
Among 100 ScanNet rooms, retrieval ranks the true room first for only 28.6% of frames.
blocks.zh:
描述器将一个点周围的形状或颜色概括为矢量,这样就能够两次看到相同的表面相匹配.
点云注册方法花时间计算这些描述符并寻找一致的匹配.
即使在单间房,BUFFER-X [39] 每帧用中位数1.4 s, RTX 2080上的GEDI 24 s 当指定对齐重叠的片段时 Ti 。
在建筑尺度上,搜索单独的房间或立方体重复工作.
图像检索可以缩小搜索范围,但选择错误的房间在提出估计开始前会失去帧.
在100个ScanNet房间中,只有28.6%的帧将真正的房间排在首位.

blocks.en:
Our starting point is that finding the place and refining the pose need different levels of accuracy ( Fig. 2 ).
Point-to-plane refinement adjusts a pose by pulling frame points onto nearby surfaces of the point cloud.
It is a variant of iterative closest point (ICP) [ 3 , 8 ] .
Nearby initial poses often converge to the same result, within a region we call the refinement basin.
On real ScanNet frames, Kolibri and BUFFER-X both start in this region for 62% of frames.
Refinement gives the same success or failure outcome on 99% of those frames ( Fig. 4 a).
The learned component therefore needs to find candidate places close enough for refinement.
Color helps: adding color to Fast Point Feature Histograms (FPFH) [ 36 ] , a geometric descriptor, doubles recall at 5 cm with our pose estimator ( Tab. 4 ).
blocks.zh:
我们的出发点是,寻找位置和完善姿势需要不同的精确度(图2)。
点对飞机的精细化通过把帧点拉到点云的附近表面来调整姿势.
它是迭代最近点(ICP)[3,8]的一个变体.
在我们称之为精炼盆地的区域内,接近初始阶段往往达到同样的结果。
在真实的ScanNet帧上,Kolibri和BUFFER-X都在这个区域开始62%的帧.
完善后,99%的这些框架的成败结果相同(图4a)。
因此,学习到的构成部分需要找到适合完善的人选。
色彩帮助:在快点特征直方图(FPFH)[36]中添加颜色,一个几何描述符,在5厘米时与我们的姿势估计符(Tab. 4 )进行重复回溯.

blocks.en:
Kolibri uses a graph network of 55,712 parameters to describe cells, 10 cm cubes of pooled points, from their color, local shape and neighbors ( Fig. 3 ).
The point cloud is described once and reused.
Groups of consistent cell matches propose candidate poses, refinement adjusts them, and a geometric fit score selects the result.
Color proposes the place and geometry decides, as color aids coarse scene recognition in humans [ 27 ] .

Kolibri使用一个由55,712个参数组成的图网来描述细胞,集合点的10厘米立方体,来自它们的颜色,局部形状和邻居(图3 ).
点云被描述一次并被重复使用.
一致的细胞匹配组提出候选姿势,精细调整,一个几何匹配分数选择结果.
彩色提出地点和几何决定,因为彩色辅助器在人类中粗糙的场景识别[27].

blocks.en:
This division of work needs colors that agree between the frame and point cloud up to a change in brightness and contrast.
On gray frames, RGB GeoTransformer, a point cloud registration method with color input, has 43 points higher recall than Kolibri at 5 cm.
Point cloud registration methods also achieve higher recall in a laser scan colored by a different camera ( Sec. 4.6 ).
blocks.zh:
这种分工需要色调在帧和点云之间一致,直至亮度和对比度的变化.
在灰色帧上,RGB GeoTransformer,一种带有色彩输入的点云注册方法,比Kolibri在5厘米高43分.
点云登记方法在用不同相机涂色的激光扫描中也实现了更高的回溯 (第4.6节)

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A division of RGB-D localization into place finding and pose refinement, supported by measurements of when different initial poses give the same refinement outcome. • Kolibri, a small graph network that finds the place from color. With matched refinement, it is competitive with point cloud registration methods on unseen rooms and a held-out test, at a small fraction of their cost. • Search without a room label. Kolibri searches 100 rooms within 1.3 points of its room-given recall, and a hospital emergency department in 384 ms per frame.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Point cloud registration methods combine descriptors with an estimator that rejects inconsistent matches [ 14 , 46 ] .
Descriptors progressed from hand-crafted local geometry [ 36 ] to learned representations and matchers [ 49 , 18 , 34 , 48 , 33 , 1 ] , including methods that transfer across sensors and scales [ 39 ] .
Colored ICP [ 31 ] and ColorPCR [ 25 ] use color during alignment.
These methods start anew for each pair.
Our reference point cloud is known in advance, so its descriptors can be reused.
The layer exchanging features between neighboring cells, following EdgeConv [ 45 ] , only needs to find starting poses for refinement.
blocks.zh:
点云登记方法结合了描述符和一个拒绝不一致匹配的估算符[14,46].
描述器从手工制作的局部几何[36]发展到学习的表达和配对[49,18,34,48,33,1],包括跨越传感器和天平传输的方法[39].
彩色CP[31]和彩色PCR[25]在对齐时使用彩色.
这些方法对每一对都重新开始。
我们的参考点云是事先知道的,所以它的描述符可以被重用.
在EdgeConv [45] 之后,相邻细胞之间的层间交换特征,只需要找到改进的起始姿势.

blocks.en:
Scene coordinate regression trains a model for each scene to predict the scene position of each image pixel [ 40 , 4 , 6 ] .
It is accurate on 7-Scenes [ 40 ] and 12-Scenes [ 43 ] , where uncertainty in the reference poses limits measurable accuracy [ 5 ] .
blocks.zh:
场景坐标回归为每个场景运行一个模型,以预测每个图像像素的场景位置[40,4,6].
在7-Scases [40]和12-Scases [43] 上准确,其中引用中的不确定性限制了可测量的准确性[5].

blocks.en:
Other methods predict scene coordinates or relative poses without training on the query scene.
They use reference images with known poses or spatial coordinates [ 47 , 41 , 35 , 11 ] .
MeshLoc [ 30 ] matches against rendered mesh views, while general-purpose models of scene geometry match image pairs [ 44 , 22 ] .
Our depth input instead supports direct matching to an existing point cloud.
MASt3R and Reloc3r, which relate the query to reference images, have lower recall than Kolibri when those images are rendered from the point cloud ( Sec. 4.2 ).
blocks.zh:
其他方法预测场景坐标或相对姿势,而不在查询场进行培训.
它们使用已知的姿势或空间坐标的参考图像[47、41、35、11]。
MeshLoc [30] 匹配对映成网视图,而场景几何的通用模型匹配图像对映[44,22].
我们的深度输入支持直接匹配到现有的点云 。
MAT3R和Reloc3r将查询与参考图像联系起来,当这些图像从点云中渲染出来时,它们比Kolibri的记忆更低(第4.2节)。

blocks.en:
A common approach retrieves likely places with an image descriptor [ 2 , 28 ] , then estimates the pose within them [ 37 ] .
Place recognition from laser scans retrieves the matching region of a large point cloud [ 20 , 42 ] .
Image-to-point-cloud methods also use retrieval or restrict the search to regions near known poses [ 32 , 23 , 21 ] .
Systems that estimate scene geometry and camera poses together [ 26 , 19 ] solve a different task from localization in a prior scan.
Kolibri searches all rooms together, without an earlier room decision that can discard the correct place.
blocks.zh:
一种共同的方法可以检索可能带有图像描述符的地方[2,28],然后估计其中的姿势[37].
激光扫描中的位置识别可以检索大点云的匹配区域[20,42].
图像对点-云方法还使用检索或将搜索限制在接近已知区域[32、23、21]。
估计场景几何和相机的系统组合[26,19]在前一次扫描中解决了与本地化不同的任务.
Kolibri将所有房间一起搜索,没有更早的房间决定可以丢弃正确的地点.

Repeated furniture can produce a large group of consistent matches at the wrong place.
The estimator therefore keeps several distinct candidates.
It retains the 4 best first-round candidates separated by at least 0.5 m or 10°.
It removes matches explained by these poses, with residuals below 0.5 m, then makes 2 further rounds.
Each round adds its best candidate if distinct and supported by at least 50% as many agreeing matches, or inliers, as the best first candidate.
There are at most 6 candidates.

Point-to-plane ICP refines each candidate using 1,000 frame points sampled at even steps through the frame.
It aligns these points to the planes of their nearest point cloud neighbors for 10 iterations.
The correspondence radius shrinks from 20 cm to 5 cm.
The fit score counts how many sampled points lie within 3 cm of the point cloud, and the highest-scoring candidate wins.
Describing the frame takes 3.8 ms of the total 82 ms per frame.
Candidate refinement accounts for most of the remaining time.

blocks.en: 3.4 Operating points
blocks.zh: 3.4 操作点

blocks.en:
The pipeline above is our standard setting, Fast .
Two optional operations trade time for accuracy or tolerance to color changes, without retraining. Precise adds a tighter second refinement to every candidate.
It uses point-to-plane ICP with Tukey weights, which suppress large residuals, at scale 5 cm and a radius that shrinks from 10 cm.
The color pass adds another reading of the frame.
A shared affine transform of its color channels matches its luminance mean and spread to those of the point cloud.
Both the original and adjusted colors go through the full pipeline.
The fit score selects the adjusted reading only if it fits strictly better.
Unless stated otherwise, Kolibri uses Fast with one color reading.

上面的管道是我们的标准设定,快。
两个可选的操作用时间交换准确性或对颜色变化的耐受性,而不进行再培训. 准确性为每个候选人增加了更严格的第二次改进。
它使用点对飞机的比较方案,带有Tukey权重,它抑制大片残基,在5厘米尺度上,半径从10厘米缩小.

原色和调整后的颜色都通过整个管道。
适配分只有在完全适合时才选择调整后的读数.
除非另有说明,Kolibri使用一种颜色读数的Fast.

blocks.en: 3.5 Training
blocks.zh: 3.5 培训

blocks.en:
Training uses 170 rooms, disjoint from every evaluation set: 165 ScanNet rooms [ 10 ] and 5 spaces in a university building.
Color and depth views rendered along walks provide the training frames.
No real camera frame enters training.
Augmentations include depth noise that grows with squared range, changes in scale, brightness, contrast and white balance, and missing sectors.
For each frame cell, the positive match is the point cloud cell nearest its true position, if within 0.5 m.
The loss is cross-entropy over the softmax matching weights.
Training uses AdamW with learning rate 0.001 for 18,600 steps of 8 views, taking at most 53 minutes on an RTX 4090.

沿行走的颜色和深度视图提供了培训框架。
没有真相机框进入训练.
增殖包括深度噪声随平方范围增长,尺度变化,亮度,对比度和白色平衡,以及缺失扇区.
对于每个框架单元格,正比对是距离其真实位置最近的点云细胞,如果在0.5米以内.
损失在软马克斯匹配重量上是交叉的。
训练使用 AdamW 的学习速率 0.001 为 18 600 步 8 视图,最多用 53 分钟的 RTX 4090 。

With the room given and refinement matched, Fast localizes 81.4% of ScanNet-96 frames within 5 cm and 5°, against GeDi’s 80.3% ( Tab. 2 ).

blocks.en:
Refinement reduces the accuracy needed from the learned descriptor.
The success rate falls to half at an initial position error of 7.7 cm ( Fig. 4 a), which defines the measured basin boundary.
Even when Fast ’s best initial candidate lies outside this basin, another candidate rescues 51% of frames, against 21% for BUFFER-X.
Increasing capacity has little effect over the tested range.
From 4,736 to 915,584 parameters, recall stays within 1.0 point of our network on the ablation rooms ( Fig. 4 b).
Training on 22 rooms also gives recall equivalent to training on all 170 ( Fig. 4 c).
blocks.zh:
精细化降低了从所学的描述符中所需的精度.
成功率在初始位置误差7.7厘米(图4a)时降至一半,该误差确定了测量的盆地边界。
即便Fast最优秀的初始候选者位于这一盆地之外,另一位候选者也抢救了51%的帧,而BUFFER-X则抢救了21%的帧。
增加能力对试验范围影响不大。
从4,736个到915,584个参数,召回时间都停留在我们网络的1.0点内,位于通化室(图4b).
22个房间的培训还提供相当于所有170个房间的培训(图4c)。

blocks.en:
What matters is the information exchanged between cells ( Tab. 4 ).
With Precise on the ablation rooms, removing message passing costs 13.4 points, and removing color costs 26.2.
Keeping only color on the same graph loses 3.4 points, so local geometry still matters.
GeDi’s descriptor uses 56 times as many parameters and localizes more frames before refinement.
That advantage disappears after refinement.
blocks.zh:
重要的是各单元格之间交换的信息(表4)。
随着精准化在通訊室,去除消息传递成本13.4分,去除色彩成本26.2.
在同一图上只保持颜色会损失3.4分,所以局部几何仍然重要.
GeDi 的描述符使用56倍的参数,在完善前将更多的帧本地化.
这种优势在完善后消失。

To separate search scale from changes in scene geometry, we place rooms apart on a grid with pitch 20 m.

The largest joins all 100 rooms from which ScanNet-96 is drawn, totaling 15.0 million points.

他们没有墙

blocks.en:
On the ten-room point cloud, Fast reaches 74.3% within 5 cm in 99 ms per frame ( and 5 a).
Its recall is equivalent to BUFFER-X given the true room.
Retrieval includes the true room in its top three for only 80.8% of frames.
Retrieve-3 + BUFFER-X therefore trails Fast by 14.0 points and takes 47 times as long.

它的召回相当于BUFFER-X,因为有真正的房间。
检索中包括了它前三的正房,只有80.8%的帧.
因此,检索-3 + BUFFER-X 快速14.0分,耗时47倍.

blocks.en:
Searching the 100-room point cloud gives 79.9% recall, only 1.3 points below a paired run given the true room.
That reference is separate from the room-given run in Tab. 2 .
Keeping several candidates is important: with one candidate, recall falls to 46.2%.
Retrieve-1 + Fast reaches only 23.9%, losing 56.0 points relative to searching all rooms.
The full search takes 168 ms and 2.15 GB per frame ( Fig. 5 b).
RGB GeoTransformer and ColorPCR exhaust the GPU from 10 rooms onward.

这个参考文献与Tab的室内文献不同。 2 (英语).

blocks.en:
The emergency department returns to our motivating setting: many connected rooms captured on foot with a handheld laser scanner and colored by its camera.
The colored point cloud spans 49 m by 42 m in plan and played no part in development or tuning.
There is no RGB-D recording.
The test therefore contains 440 RGB-D frames rendered from the scan along 30 walks, with simulated depth noise.
Their colors agree with the point cloud by construction, which favors color-based methods, and their reference poses are exact.
Kolibri searches the whole scan without a room label.
Baselines take minutes per frame, so they use 30 frames, one from the start of each walk.
blocks.zh:
应急部门恢复了我们的激励环境:许多连接的房间用手持激光扫描仪徒步捕获,并用照相机配色。
彩色点云在计划中跨度为49米乘42米,在开发或调试中没有发挥任何作用.
没有RGB-D记录.
因此,测试包含440个RGB-D帧,由30个行走方向的扫描制成,并带有模拟深度噪音.
他们的颜色通过构造与点云一致,它倾向于以颜色为基础的方法,其参考姿势是准确的.
Kolibri在没有房间标签的情况下搜索整个扫描.
基线每帧需要几分钟时间,所以它们使用30帧,从每次行走开始就使用1帧.

blocks.en:
Fast localizes 86.5% of all rendered frames within 5 cm and 5°, in 384 ms per frame on an RTX 2080 Ti ( Figs. 6 and 6 ).
GeDi on the whole point cloud reaches 26.7% on the baseline subset.
Its random sample consensus (RANSAC) estimator fits poses from sampled matches, but ends with fewer than three agreeing matches on most frames.
Searching 1,090 overlapping 3 m cubes raises GeDi’s recall to 76.7%.
The cost is 91 minutes per frame.
On these same frames, the difference between Fast and GeDi on cubes is inconclusive: +7.8 points [-7.8, +23.4].
BUFFER-X on the cubes reaches 60.0%.
blocks.zh:
快速定位在5厘米和5°以内,在RTX 2080 Ti(图6和图6)上的每帧384 ms中,所有渲染帧的86.5%。
整个点云上的GEDI在基线子集中达到26.7%.
其随机抽样共识(RANSAC)的估算值符合抽样匹配的姿势,但以在大多数帧上商定匹配的不到三个结尾.
搜索1,090个重叠的3米立方体将GeDi的召回率提高到76.7%。
成本为每帧91分钟.
在这些相同的框架上,Fast和GeDi在立方体上的区别没有定论:+7.8分[7.8,+23.4].
立方体上的BUFFER-X达到60.0%.

blocks.en:
A sparser point cloud reduces this cost but does not close the gap.
Kolibri represents the scan with 350,087 cells for place search.
Given a keypoint per cell, 350,000 in all, GeDi reaches 43.3% in 2 minutes per frame with its best of 5 RANSAC inlier distances.
This improves both recall and time over GeDi on the full point cloud, but still takes 315 times as long as Fast for half its recall.
blocks.zh:
稀疏的点云可以降低这一成本,但不会缩小差距。
Kolibri代表扫描,有350,087个细胞进行位置搜索.
由于每个电池有一个键点,总共35万个,GeDi在每帧2分钟内达到43.3%,最佳距离为5RANSAC更远.
这在GeDi的全点云上既改善了召回,也改善了时间,但仍然需要315倍于快速的召回的一半.

blocks.en: 4.6 Operating points and dependence on color
blocks.zh: 4.6 操作点和对颜色的依赖

blocks.en:
The second refinement stage in Precise adds 35 ms per frame ( Tab. 5 ) and gains 4.0 points at 5 cm on ScanNet-96.
The color pass takes 2.3 times as long as Fast .
Across the tested color changes, including brightness shifts and conversion to gray, it gains an average 10.7 points at 0.25 m and 2° on ScanNet-10 and 11.8 on 7-Scenes.
blocks.zh:
精准版的第二改进阶段每帧增加35 ms(Tab. 5),在ScanNet-96上以5 cm得到4.0分.
颜色传球需要2.3倍的快。
在整个经过测试的颜色变化中,包括亮度变化和转换成灰色,平均在0.25米处得到10.7分,在ScanNet-10上得到2°,在7-Scens上得到11.8分.

blocks.en:
These options do not remove the dependence on color.
At the same threshold, RGB GeoTransformer leads Kolibri by 9.2 points averaged over the color shifts, and by 47.2 on gray frames.
The same limitation appears across cameras.
Bonn [ 29 ] pairs real ASUS Xtion frames with a terrestrial laser scan colored by the scanner. Fast reaches 26.3% within 0.5 m, or 47.2% with the color pass , against 91.5% for GeDi on cubes.
GeDi takes 11 minutes per frame.
Changes between recording sessions affect Fast and the six strongest refined baselines alike: they lose 16 to 25 points at 5 cm on ScanNet-96-S2 ( Tab. 2 ).
blocks.zh:
这些选项不会消除对颜色的依赖.
在同一阈值上,RGB GeoTransformer领先科利卜里在颜色变换上平均得9.2分,在灰色帧上平均得47.2分.
相机上也有同样的限制
波恩[29]对真实的ASUS Xtion帧,由扫描仪进行地面激光扫描. 在0.5米范围内快速达到26.3%,即47.2%通过色谱,而在立方体上的GeDi为91.5%.
GEDI每帧需要11分钟.
记录会话之间的变化影响 在ScanNet-96-S2(Tab. 2)上以5厘米的速度损失16至25分。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Kolibri uses color to find candidate places and geometric refinement to set the pose.
With matched refinement, a small network reaches the accuracy of point cloud registration methods in single rooms at a fraction of their cost.
The saved time makes it practical to search a point cloud spanning 100 rooms or a hospital emergency department without a room label.
Agreement in color remains essential, and point cloud registration methods retain the lead when it breaks.
Extending search to whole buildings calls for a hierarchy that reduces work without discarding the correct place before refinement.
blocks.zh:
Kolibri使用颜色来寻找候选位置,并进行几何改进来设定姿势.
经过相应的完善,一个小型网络以成本的一小部分在单间达到点云登记方法的准确性。
节省的时间使得搜索一个横跨100个房间的点云,或者一个没有房间标签的医院急诊部门,变得实用.
颜色上的一致仍然至关重要,点云登记方法在断层时保留领先地位。
将搜索范围扩大到整个建筑,要求分级减少工作,而不在完善前丢弃正确位置.

blocks.en: Appendix S1 What color contributes
blocks.zh: 附录S1 颜色贡献

blocks.en:
People recognize scene categories from brief glimpses [ 16 , 38 ] , using coarse visual structure before fine edges [ 38 ] .
Color helps most at this coarse scale [ 27 , 7 ] , especially when a scene category has characteristic colors [ 27 ] .
Recognizing a place and orienting within it engage different brain systems [ 12 , 13 ] .
Facing direction is represented relative to the local environment [ 24 ] , and young children reorient using room shape even when a wall has a distinctive color [ 17 ] .
This distinction has a parallel in Kolibri: color identifies candidate places, and geometry sets the pose.
blocks.zh:
人们从短暂的窥视中识别出场景类别[16,38],在细边缘前使用粗细的视觉结构[38].
色彩在这个粗糙的尺度上帮助最多[27,7],特别是当一个场景类别具有特征颜色[27].
认识其中的一个位置和方向,涉及不同的大脑系统[12,13].
面对的方向相对于当地环境来说是代表的[24],即使墙面有明显的颜色,年幼的儿童也会使用房间形状重新定向[17].
这种区分在Kolibri中有一个平行:颜色识别候选位置,几何设定姿势.

Table S2 gives the full results on 10 rooms evaluated once after the method was frozen.

Comparisons with the other baselines favor Kolibri or are inconclusive.

On rendered views, matched refinement makes Kolibri equivalent to ColorPCR and ahead of the remaining baselines.

blocks.en: Appendix S4 Search without a room label
blocks.zh: 附录S4 无房间标签的搜索

blocks.en:
The point cloud in Sec. 4.4 joins 100 ScanNet rooms placed apart on a grid, totaling 15.0 million points.
Queries are all 7,986 first-session frames of ScanNet-96. Table S3 compares search over all rooms with a paired run on the same frames given the true room.
This reference run is separate from the room-given results in Table 2 .

塞克4.4中的点云将100个ScanNet房间连接在一个网格上,总计1500万点.
查询是ScanNet-96的所有7,986个第一会场框架. 表S3比较了所有房间的搜索情况,给出了真实房间的同一帧上的对数运行情况。
这一参考记录与表2中提供的房间结果不同。

Table S3 : Searching all rooms has a small recall cost. Recall uses 5 cm and 5°.
The loss compares all-room search with a paired run given the true room, with an interval over walks.

blocks.en:
Several candidates are important even with refinement fixed.
Keeping only one reduces all-room recall to 46.2%.
The image descriptor DINOv2 ranks the true room first for 28.6% of frames and in the top three for 44.7%.
Running Fast in the top room gives 23.9% recall, 56.0 points below searching all rooms, with interval [ 53.3 , 58.6 ] [53.3,58.6] .
All-room search places 98.0% of frames in the correct room.
blocks.zh:
有几个候选人很重要,即使有固定的改进。
只保留一个,所有房间的召回率将减少到46.2%。
图像描述器DINOv2将真房排在28.6%的帧前,排在前三位的框前44.7%.
在顶房跑快让23.9%的观众回想起,下面56.0点搜索所有房间,间隔[53.3,58.6] [53.3,58.6].
所有房间的搜索位置98.0%的帧在正确的房间.

blocks.en:
Both finer and coarser cells reduce recall on the ScanNet-10 ablation rooms.
Relative to the 10 cm default, cells of 5 cm and 20 cm lose 2.3 and 1.9 points at 5 cm and 5°.
Median times are 249, 82 and 90 ms for fine, default and coarse cells respectively.
Fine cells exhaust the RTX 2080 Ti on 40% of ScanNet-10 frames, so their recall is measured on an RTX 4090.

更精细的和较粗的细胞减少ScanNet-10 剪切室的召回.
相对于10厘米默认值,5厘米和20厘米的细胞在5厘米和5°时损失2.3和1.9分.
中位数分别为249,82和90毫秒的精细,默认和粗细的细胞.
精细的细胞在ScanNet-10框架的40%上耗尽了RTX 2080 Ti,所以它们的召回量是在RTX 4090上测量的.

blocks.en: Appendix S5 The hospital emergency department
blocks.zh: 附录S5 医院急诊部

blocks.en:
The colored point cloud contains 2.1 million points and spans 49 by 42 m in plan.
There is no RGB-D recording, so the test frames are rendered from the scan.
Each of the 30 walks starts at a random walkable position and takes up to 20 steps of 0.5 m.
The camera height ranges from 1.5 to 1.7 m, with a downward tilt of up to 20°.
Each point is rendered in its own color as a square of half-size 2 cm.
Simulated sensor noise perturbs depth, while colors agree with the point cloud by construction.
Frames require depth on at least 30% of pixels and a median depth of at least 0.8 m.
This leaves 440 frames, shown in Fig. 6 .
Baselines use the first frame of each walk.
blocks.zh:
彩点云包含210万个点,计划跨度49乘42米.
没有RGB-D的录制,因此测试帧是通过扫描得到的.
30步中每步从随机可步行的位置开始,最多走20步0.5米.
相机高度在1.5至1.7米之间,向下倾斜至20°.
每个点都是用自己的颜色做成半大小2厘米的方形.
模拟传感器噪音扰动深度,而颜色则通过构造与点云一致.
框架要求至少30%像素的深度和至少0.8米的中位深度.
留下440帧,以图6显示。
基线使用每个行走的第一个框架.

blocks.en:
GeDi’s starting configuration describes every point and uses an inlier distance of 2 cm, calibrated on room development frames.
This distance determines which matches agree with a candidate pose in its random sample consensus (RANSAC) estimator.
On the full point cloud, most frames end with fewer than three agreeing matches. Table S4 varies both the number of described points and the inlier distance.
Sparser descriptions reduce time, while wider inlier distances allow agreement among more of the remaining matches.
Across the 11 tested settings, the best whole-point-cloud recall at 5 cm and 5° is 43.3%.
Searching separate 3 m cubes raises recall to 76.7%, at 91 minutes per frame.
blocks.zh:
GeDi的起始配置描述了每个点,并使用2厘米的更远的距离,在房间开发框架上校准.
这一距离决定了与候选人在其随机抽样共识(RANSAC)估计器中表达何种对应。
在全点云上,大多数帧的结尾不到三个同意的匹配. 表S4中说明的点数和距离都不同。
Sparser描述缩短了时间,而更宽的距离则允许更多的剩余匹配者达成协议.
在经过测试的11个设置中,5厘米和5°的最佳全点云召回率为43.3%。
单独搜索3米立方体,将召回率提高到76.7%,每帧91分钟.

blocks.en:
Table S5 separates GeDi’s descriptors from the size of its search.
Regions of the scan are cut around each of the 30 frames with the true pose, and GeDi runs with its calibrated settings and no refinement.
On a 3 m cube around the points a frame sees, GeDi places 50.0% of the frames within 5 cm and 5°.
Recall falls steadily as the region grows, to 13.3% on the largest square, and the share of frames for which GeDi returns a pose falls from 100% to 40%.
The descriptors work in the emergency department, and the whole-scan result is the cost of matching against a large point cloud.
The cube search recovers recall by running many small searches and keeping the cube with the most agreeing matches.
blocks.zh:
表S5将GeDi的描述符与其搜索大小区分开来.
扫描的区域在30帧的周围被切除,每帧都有真实的姿势,而GeDi运行时带有其校准的设置,没有改进.
在一个3米立方体周围一个框架所看到的点上,GeDi在5厘米和5°范围内放置了50.0%的框架.
随着地区增长,GeDi回归的帧比例从100%下降到40%。
描述器在应急部门工作,全扫描结果就是比对大点云的成本.
立方体搜索通过运行许多小搜索和保存最同意的匹配的立方体来恢复记忆.

表S5:随着搜索区域的增长,GeDi的召回稳步下降。 GeDi在每次行走的第一个框架上使用其校准设置而无精度.

blocks.en: Appendix S6 BUFFER-X and the size of the point cloud
blocks.zh: 附录S6 BUFFER-X和点云的大小

blocks.en:
BUFFER-X [ 39 ] registers two partially overlapping point clouds.
It derives its patch radii from the larger input point cloud. Its released code caps them at 5 m and samples a fixed number of keypoints from each input.
As the reference point cloud grows, the patches grow and the keypoint budget spreads across more space.
On the grid of rooms in Appendix S4 , the median largest radius rises from 0.75 m for one room to 1.08 m for two and 2.50 m for five.
It reaches the cap from 10 rooms onward.
At this scale, patches describe rooms rather than local surfaces.
The paper therefore evaluates BUFFER-X only on single rooms and 3 m cubes.
blocks.zh:
BUFFER-X [39] 登记了两个部分重叠的点云。
它从更大的输入点云中获取它的补丁光度. 其发布的代码封顶在5米处,从每次输入中抽取固定数量的键点.
随着参考点云的增多,补丁不断增长,关键点预算分散在更多的空间.
在附录S4中的房间网格上,最大中间半径从一个房间的0.75米上升到两个房间的1.08米,五个房间的2.5米。
从10个房间到顶部
在这个尺度上,补丁描述的是房间而不是局部表面.
因此,该文件只在单室和3米立方体上评价BUFFER-X。

blocks.en:
Taking the radii from the frame instead does not improve the room-given result.
On 871 ScanNet-10 frames, this reduces the median largest radius from 0.84 to 0.33 m.
With shared refinement, recall falls from 74.7% to 72.2% at 5 cm and 5°, and from 92.9% to 90.0% at 0.5 m and 5°.
The room-given comparisons retain the released radius rule.
blocks.zh:
取出画框的光线并不能改善房间得到的结果。
在871 ScanNet-10帧上,这将中位最大半径从0.84米降低到0.33米.
经过共同改进,5厘米和5°的召回率从74.7%下降到72.2%,0.5米和5°的召回率从92.9%下降到90.0%。
室生比较保留了释放半径规则.

blocks.en: Appendix S7 A point cloud colored by another camera
blocks.zh: 附录S7 另一台相机所显示的点云

blocks.en:
In Bonn [ 29 ] , the query frames and the point cloud come from different sensors.
Its 597 test frames come from the static ASUS Xtion RGB-D sequence, with motion-capture reference poses.
The same room is represented by a terrestrial laser scan colored by the scanner’s camera.
Kolibri searches the full point cloud with its room-unknown settings.
GeDi searches both the full point cloud and overlapping 3 m cubes.
BUFFER-X receives only cubes, following Appendix S6 .
blocks.zh:
在波恩[29]中,查询框和点云来自不同的传感器.
其597个试验框来自静态的ASUS Xtion RGB-D序列,带有运动捕捉参考物的姿势.
同一房间由扫描仪照相机显示的地面激光扫描。
Kolibri用其室外未知的设置搜索全点云.
GEDI搜索全点云和重叠的3米立方体.
BUFFER-X只接收立方体,遵循附录S6。

blocks.en:
The cameras record the same walls in different colors, and Kolibri has low recall ( Tab. S6 ). Fast reaches 26.3% within 0.5 m and 5°, or 47.2% with the color pass .
GeDi, which does not use color, reaches 77.1% on the whole point cloud and 91.5% on cubes.
Its median times are 2.8 and 11 minutes per frame respectively.
This is the boundary of the main paper’s gains: ScanNet, 7-Scenes and 12-Scenes use the same kind of camera for frames and point clouds, while the hospital’s rendered colors agree by construction.
blocks.zh:
相机以不同的颜色记录了同样的墙壁,而科利布里的召回率很低(Tab. S6. ). 快速达到26.3%在0.5米和5°以内,或47.2%的颜色通过.
不使用颜色的GEDI在整点云上达到77.1%,在立方体上达到91.5%.
其中间时间分别为每帧2.8分钟和11分钟.
这是主要报纸收益的界限: ScanNet, 7-Scees和12-Scees用同样的相机来装帧和点云, 而医院的颜色则通过建造而一致。

blocks.en: Appendix S8 Camera and lens properties
blocks.zh: 附录 S8 相机和镜头属性

blocks.en:
A deployed camera can differ from the development cameras in its lens and its calibration.
We change one property of the query camera at a time on the 871 real ScanNet-10 frames and leave the colored point cloud unchanged ( Tab. S7 ).
A narrower lens keeps only the points inside a horizontal field of view of 45° or 30°, where the ScanNet depth camera sees 58°.
A focal length 5 or 10% too long or too short scales each frame across the optical axis.
Uncorrected radial distortion with coefficient k 1 k_{1} moves each point away from the image center for positive k 1 k_{1} (pincushion) or toward it for negative k 1 k_{1} (barrel), in proportion to its squared distance from the center.
A color offset pairs each depth pixel with the color 5 or 10 pixels to its right.
BUFFER-X and GeDi receive the same frames and the shared refinement.
blocks.zh:
部署的相机可以不同于其镜头及其校准中的开发相机.
我们一次在871个真实的ScanNet-10帧上更改一个查询相机属性,并将彩色点云保留不变(Tab. S7 ).
较窄的镜头只保留在45°或30°的横向视场内的点,其中ScanNet深度相机视界为58°.
一个焦距5或10%太长或太短的尺度,每个框架横跨光学轴.
未修正的带系数 k 1 k_{1} 的射线扭曲 将正值 k 1 k_{1} (pincushion) 的图像中心移开, 或向负值 k 1 k_{1} (barrel) 移开, 按其与中心平方距离的比例 。
一个颜色抵消对每个深度像素,其右侧的颜色为5或10像素.
BUFFER-X和GeDi得到相同的框架和共同的改进。

blocks.en:
Calibration errors distort the frame itself, so they cost every method alike.
With a focal length 10% too long, Fast localizes 30.3% of the frames within 0.25 m and 2°, GeDi 29.5% and BUFFER-X 30.3%, against 86.9% for Fast on unchanged frames.
The place is still found: within 0.5 m and 5°, Fast keeps at least 90.3% at every focal error.
The scaled frame cannot fit the point cloud closely, and the second refinement stage of Precise ends below Fast at all 4 focal errors.
Distortion costs Fast at most 8.0 points.
In 16 of 16 comparisons over the focal and distortion levels, the losses of Fast and of a baseline are equivalent within 3 points (Sec. 4.1 ).
